axiom_gate.reason: The result is a descent, normalizer, and compact-form classification of a single derived Prym object.

correction_gate.reason: Sato-Tate uses a maximal compact of Hg(C)=GL4(C); U(3)xU(1) is instead a maximal compact of Hg(R)=U(3,1).
correction_gate.downstream_effect: Mumford-Tate, monodromy, Hodge, and Tate conclusions unchanged

hard_boundaries: The group is classified up to conjugacy in USp(8).
Analytic Haar equidistribution is not asserted.
The real Hodge-domain compact subgroup U(3)xU(1) must not be confused with ST^0.
No new axiom or Foundation primitive is proposed.
